patterns.title: Action / movement / aiming
patterns.condition: Continuous world-space path, threat or aim reading is the main task
patterns.composition: Scene-led; peripheral status and local command groups
patterns.protected_region: Actual threat/aim/next landing and avatar visibility
patterns.first_action: First controllable input and visible consequence
patterns.exception: During actual pause/local inspection a decision plane can dominate

patterns.title: Puzzle / board / spatial manipulation
patterns.condition: The player reasons over an active board and its consequences
patterns.composition: Board/decision-led with connected status, next object and recovery
patterns.protected_region: Complete relevant board and manipulated objects
patterns.exception: A puzzle can have a nonrectangular field or scene-led movement

patterns.title: Turn / card / tactical choice
patterns.condition: A discrete action must be inspected and committed
patterns.composition: Current actor/object, legal choice, cost and consequence in one scan unit
patterns.exception: Fast real-time card play can also need protected live scene

patterns.title: Management / economy / strategy
patterns.condition: Repeated values and conditions drive comparison
patterns.composition: Aligned rows/table or graph/detail decision plane where comparison is real
patterns.protected_region: Comparable units, current/required predicates and selected context
patterns.first_action: Inspect values -> supported local commitment -> acknowledgement
patterns.exception: Visual identity or exploratory browsing can favor subject pane; no table mandate

patterns.title: RPG / exploration / collection
patterns.condition: World exploration alternates with inspecting objects, upgrades or equipment
patterns.composition: Scene-led live view; concentrated local task surface
patterns.protected_region: Path/encounter corridor in play; safe ink/comparison in local menus
patterns.first_action: Real interaction opener then actual qualified change
patterns.exception: Parchment, circles and ornate panels are sample art choices, not RPG requirements

patterns.title: Social / party / lobby / survival
patterns.condition: People choose session/readiness or stay aware of live events
patterns.composition: Identity, true prerequisites, readiness and next commitment together
patterns.protected_region: Session/member status and live hazard/objective when unpaused
patterns.exception: No invented Host/Join menu; social/chat may itself be the primary task

patterns.title: Web / app / media / service
patterns.condition: Read, compare, navigate or complete a service rather than move in a world
patterns.composition: Content-led task plane with stable utilities and meaningful state
patterns.first_action: Real command or navigation and its actual result
patterns.exception: Do not transplant game relief/HUD, assume a scene, or fabricate external-service actions
